segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on as executive producer, identifying himself as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Hype Train Piss Freestyle & Subscriber Thanks
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the return broadcast with a ten-minute piss-themed freestyle rap, thanking subscribers while advancing the theory that urine is stored in the balls via ghost artists painting it into Tupperware.

segments.title: Trump Deploys National Guard to DC
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins Case at the news desk to cover Trump's invocation of the D.C. Home Rule Act to federalize the Metropolitan Police and deploy 800 National Guard troops, citing crime statistics that show violent crime actually declining since 2023.

segments.title: Trailer Watching: Haunted Hotel, One Piece S2, Jordan Peele Football Horror, Highway to Hell
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple react to four trailers: Netflix's animated Haunted Hotel, One Piece Season 2 live-action, Jordan Peele's football horror film, and the 1991 cult film Highway to Hell.

segments.title: Gatorade vs Powerade Debate Derailed by Crum's Missing Penis
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate sports drinks while Crum reveals his penis is missing, he holds a devil's key in his soul, suffers flaming pigeon visions, and everything tastes like sardines; Munch claims he visited hell and was promised resurrection.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Reads AI Porn Addiction & Medical Oddities
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon reads stories on AI-generated porn addiction ('gooners'), Ozempic anti-aging study, a woman selling toenails for $80k/year, persistent genital arousal disorder, and tarantulas with massive penises.

segments.title: How to Scat and How to Skank
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget attempts to learn scatting from the Scatman and a vocal coach, then skanking from a ska tutorial, while his dead father's board heckles and reveals brother Jet performed at the Scatman's funeral.

segments.title: Kendelle's Foot Injury & Foot Puppet Rap Diagnosis
segments.notes: Kendelle calls in with a bruised heel from Lake Tahoe; DJ Newsic introduces a foot puppet rapper who delivers medical advice in verse before the musical sign-off and raid.

lore_notes.fact: Crum's penis is missing; he has a key in his soul from the devil, sees flaming pigeon visions, everything tastes like sardines, hears ancient grumbling at doors.
Munch visited hell, spoke to Fiona (who rejected him), and was promised resurrection by the devil.
Peter Gibbon says the devil gave him a special light for the wall crawlspace.
Jeb Nogget smashed his face into a well bottom, required months of facial reassembly.
Jeb's brother Jet performed at the Scatman's funeral per the Scatman's last wish.
Kendelle bruised her heel on slippery rocks at Lake Tahoe, possibly bone bruise, not swelling.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a Lake Tahoe vacation to anchor a broadcast dominated by Hype Train's extended piss-themed freestyle, followed by Jeff Ripple covering Trump's deployment of National Guard to DC under the Home Rule Act. The show cycles through trailer reactions (Haunted Hotel, One Piece Season 2, Jordan Peele football horror, Highway to Hell), a Munch & Crum debate on Gatorade vs Powerade interrupted by Crum's missing penis and hell visions, Peter Gibbon reading news about AI porn addiction and medical oddities, Jeb Nogget's How To segment on scatting and skanking, and Kendall's foot injury diagnosed by a rapping foot puppet. The broadcast ends with DJ Newsic's musical sign-off and a raid.
